title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds Update v1.0.1.1 HOTFIX! Save Fixes, Server Crashes & Patch Notes
author: NRS NEO
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds has received a new hotfix, bringing important fixes for controller users and dedicated server owners! In this video, we break down the latest patch notes, explain what has been fixed, and look at the issues that still need attention.

Here's what we're covering:

✅ Fixed the corrupted save file popup issue affecting controller users.

✅ Fixed dedicated server crashes caused by ranged special attacks hitting certain enemies.

🎮 Nintendo Switch 2 players can continue crossplay with players who have already updated, even while waiting for the console update.

⚡ The Air Staff's fourth combo hit is still not applying on hit damage.

📦 Splitting item stacks inside chests can still cause the game to freeze.

🛠️ The team is targeting fixes for the Air Staff and chest inventory issues, with additional testing and console platform approval required.

We'll also look back at the previous update, including the new jump attacks, questing improvements, and increased inventory space, to see how these changes fit into the game's ongoing improvements.

What do you think about the latest Dragonwilds hotfix? Are you still experiencing save issues, chest freezes, or problems with the Air Staff? Let us know in the comments!

Thanks for watching, adventurers!

#RuneScapeDragonwilds
